column3: The Rhapsody of the Departure Eve
Right, this is for you.
W-What's this? It's kinda blackened with ink.
It's a list of souvenirs, I want all of them. If you forget any one of them...
S-So many!
You mean "So few". Is there anything you're unhappy with?
Of course there is! Why do I have to buy so many things?!
I-I'll see what I can do about it... when the time comes.
I'll see? What do you mean?
You know, I already gave you some leeway by extending your deadline to complete "SisSis", didn't I?
Those are two different things!
Huu. Are you saying that there's no way to accomplish both of them?
That's exactly what I mean!
Why do I need to bring back so many souvenirs?
No, bringing back souvenirs is fine, but at least ask properly!
Buy them for me.
You know...
You don't have any right to object.
I'll take that as an agreement.
Well, it's a given to listen to the cute, sexy, bright me's request, right?
It's not convenient for me you know!
This is a school trip, so I have limited free time.
It's unlikely that I can buy them all since there's so many!
You'll manage somehow; it has nothing to do with me.
I'll do what I can, so deal with it.
Promise me.
How persistent!
Why are you staring blankly at me? Gross.
I'm dumbfounded! Shocked!
Anyway, it's a promise.
I'm not too unreasonable. I fully understand that you feel inferior to the perfect me, but there's no need to be like this.
How are you perfect!
Well, I'll leave it to you anyway. Please take care of it.
...I get it.
It's useless... My words won't get through at all.
Anyway, I'm counting on you.
Yeah yeah, I'm being counted on.
Dumbfounded?
Ah, did my awesomeness take you by surprise?
How did it change like that from what we were talking about?!
Your loud voice is proof enough. Fine, I'm counting on you. Thanks. That's all.
Huh... Damn, I don't have a choice...
I'm too tired to retort anymore...
So, why are you just staring blankly?!
Whatever you say, you big S.
I get it; silence is consent.
I～～～～ get it! Damn it...!
